No consumer, tool, runtime, research run, or experiment is activated.

No Observation, Measurement Result, or Finding is accepted as fact, decision, Definition, proof, Product value, or policy.
admission_prerequisites: All 18 exact artifact, schema, example, materialization, refinement, and receipt digests remain current.
All semantic Definition bindings remain admitted and digest-current.
The owner approves this complete model as one atomic batch.
The bound axis-orthogonal Relation Kind model and no-collapse receipt remain digest-current and passing.
claim_ceiling: This complete model proves that the exact 18 candidate Artifact Type packages were revised as one coherent model, bound to admitted Definitions, checked for exact duplicates and close overlaps, and validated against their fixtures. It does not admit the Artifact Types or any instances and does not activate consumers or behavior.

entries.name: Finding
entries.purpose: Records one attributable evidence-bounded conclusion derived from exact Research Runs and Evidence Sets, with question fidelity, support assessment, counterevidence, limitations, lifecycle, ownership, challengeability, revisions, successors, and an explicit claim ceiling.

entries.name: Measurement Method
entries.purpose: Defines one residue-entropy observable after a declared source operation, including entropy register, typed residue, mathematical reading, scope, procedure, uncertainty, claim status, authority treatment, and interpretation.

entries.name: Measurement Result
entries.purpose: Records one attributable residue-entropy result produced by an exact Measurement Method, preserving entropy register, source operation, typed residue, mathematical reading, scope, uncertainty, claim status, authority treatment, evidence, and receipt.

entries.name: Observation
entries.purpose: Records one attributable perception or instrument readout during a Research Run or Experiment Run, including method, conditions, provenance, uncertainty, and limitations.

dependencies: Product Identity, Product Thesis, Product Capability, and Capability Realization Binding (optional product evaluation)
entries.name: Experiment Design
entries.purpose: Defines one pre-run empirical test with explicit Project and Goal linkage, optional Research Inquiry and Product evaluation context, hypothesis, protocol, variables, measures, prerequisites, stop rules, timestamps, ownership, and challenge route.

entries.name: Experiment Run
entries.purpose: Records one attributable execution of an exact Experiment Design while preserving its Project, Goal, optional Research Inquiry trace, and optional Product evaluation context together with actual inputs, environment, interventions, deviations, observations, measurements, timing, and stop state.

entries.name: Ontology
entries.purpose: Defines one governed meaning layer as typed nodes, typed relations, branch and role context, provenance, confidence, promotion state, and use obligations.

entries.name: Context Profile
entries.purpose: Carries reusable construction and resolution policy derived from the admitted Context contract, including anchor rules, source eligibility, freshness, exclusions, output constraints, and succession, without representing a Context instance.

entries.name: Context
entries.purpose: Defines one durable owner-qualified boundary of relevance and interpretation for a purpose, exact Product, optional Project or Goal, consumers, subject scope, and source policies.

entries.name: Context Request
entries.purpose: Records one bounded attributable request to resolve an exact Context version for named consumers and uses under explicit selectors, freshness, exclusions, budget, and output constraints.

entries.name: Context View
entries.purpose: Records one immutable digest-bound projection resolving an exact Context Request against one Context version and source epoch, including included and excluded material, lineage, limitations, and expiry.

entries.name: Model Instance Binding
entries.purpose: Binds one exact governed parent model to one locally owned instance while separating inherited contract, extensions, owners, authority scopes, conformance, and lifecycle.

entries.name: Person Reference
entries.purpose: Provides one minimal purpose-bounded reference to a Person while limiting exposed personal data and separating the reference from identity claims, accounts, roles, memberships, and authority.

entries.name: Identity Claim
entries.purpose: Records one attributable challengeable assertion that a Person Reference denotes a particular identifier under declared evidence and assurance policy.

entries.name: Role
entries.purpose: Defines one reusable scope-bounded position with expected functions, responsibilities, eligible authority relations, explicit exclusions, ownership, lifecycle, and challenge route.

entries.name: Team
entries.purpose: Defines one durable owner-qualified collective identity for Persons coordinating toward a declared purpose and scope, separately from membership, roles, responsibilities, and authority.

entries.name: Team Membership
entries.purpose: Records one owner-qualified time-bounded Person-to-Team membership relation with its own lifecycle, basis, succession, and challenge route.

entries.name: Role Assignment
entries.purpose: Records one owner-qualified time-bounded assignment of a Person Reference or Team to a Role in an exact scope and lifecycle epoch, with separate responsibility and authority claims.

experiment_relations.target: Product, Product Thesis outcome, Product Capability, or realization binding
Product, Product Thesis outcome, Product Capability, or realization binding

overlap_dispositions.boundary: Context Profile carries reusable construction and resolution policy derived from the admitted Context contract. It has no Product, Project, Goal, purpose-bound Context identity, or resolved source selection and cannot validate as a Context instance.
Context defines a purpose-specific relevance and interpretation boundary anchored to Product and optionally Project or Goal. Bounded Context defines a semantic ownership boundary for a domain model.

Experiment Run executes a predeclared controlled design with variables or interventions. Research Run executes a bounded inquiry method and may be observational or analytical without an Experiment Design.

Model Instance Binding is the generic parent-to-instance authority separation contract. Capability Realization Binding is the Product Capability-specific relation with adoption and realization evidence semantics.
Ontology carries governed typed knowledge and relations. Ontology Package is a packaging carrier and does not replace the Ontology semantic identity.

relation_audit.admission_recommendation: Use the axis-orthogonal successor as the relation layer for the final review. Do not admit the superseded verb-level proposal as independent Relation Kinds.

endpoint_gaps.reason: Context is anchored to one Product. Experiments should use evaluates rather than claiming Product membership.
These carriers preserve Project scope, but the admitted migration contract does not accept their source kinds.
Empirical records and the existing Identity Graph fixture carry Method links, but the current endpoint contract only types run-to-method edges.
An Experiment can evaluate declared Product anchors, but it is not an Evaluation artifact under the current contract.
The instance is the source endpoint; Model Instance Binding remains the lifecycle-bearing relation record.
